item.title: 34 Incredible Photos Of Our Elegant Galaxy – The Milky Way
item.description: Capturing stunning photos of the Milky way can be incredibly rewarding and gear should not put you off from capturing photos of our beautiful galaxy. You can start with any camera that you have as long it has manual exposure control and a stabilising accessory like a tripod and if a light weight camera, a gorillapod will just work fine. item.title: Does High ISO Matter Anymore?
item.description: Some changes in photographic technology seem to happen at breakneck pace, others slowly, almost imperceptibly. High ISO noise is one of the latter.
